title: Finite-basis coordinates and balanced ordinary scalar composition
statement: Let C be a small category with topology J and ring sheaves R,S,U. For finite-free scalar arrows [def-sp-field-scalar-strict-limit-data], any finite basis theta of S over R determines a natural iso from scalar extension followed by restriction to the finite power functor on R-module sheaves. On pure sections [def-sfb-scalar-inverse-image-normalization] its ith coordinate is the ith coordinate of s under theta times m. Its inverse is the finite sum of the basis vectors tensored with the given module coordinates. Composite finite-free scalar arrows are finite free, and ordinary balanced scalar extension [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-section-calculus] has the associator z tensor (s tensor x) mapping to b(s)z tensor x and inverse inserting one. The induced tower associator is levelwise that associator [def-sbc-strict-projection-tower-data]. The identity arrow is finite free and has multiplication unitor r tensor x mapping to rx, also levelwise on towers. No derived functor or Roos comparison is part of this statement.

source.place: (1), finite basis, ordinary balanced associator and identity calculations

proof.text: Expand the S factor in a pure tensor in the chosen finite basis. The coordinate map is the basis coordinate of s times m. The inverse sums basis vectors tensored with the module coordinates. Both composites are identities by the basis equations and balancing. Restriction compatibility descends these maps through module sheafification. This also includes rank zero.

For composable finite-free arrows, the products of the two basis vectors form a finite basis over the first ring. The balanced reassociation sends z tensor (s tensor x) to b(s)z tensor x and its inverse inserts one. The balancing relations give both inverse identities. Apply this natural iso termwise to define AT. For an identity arrow take the rank-one basis and multiplication unitor with inverse insertion of one; apply it termwise to define UT.

theorem fieldScalarOrdinaryCoordinates :
    (∀ {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}} (a : FiniteFreeScalarArrow J R S)
          (d : ℕ) (theta : (∏ᶜ fun _ : Fin d ↦ unit (ringSheaf R)) ≅
            (restriction a.val).obj (unit (ringSheaf S))),
          ∃ phi : tensorFunctor a.val ⋙ restriction a.val ≅
              Functor.const (Discrete (Fin d)) ⋙ lim,
            (∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf R)) (V : Cᵒᵖ)
              (s : S.obj.obj V) (m : M.val.obj V) (i : Fin d),
              (phi.hom.app M ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : Fin d ↦ M) i).val.app V
                  (scalarPure a.val M V s m) =
                (theta.inv ≫ Pi.π (fun _ : Fin d ↦ unit (ringSheaf R)) i).val.app V s
                  • m) ∧
            (∀ (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf R)) (V : Cᵒᵖ)
              (x : ((Functor.const (Discrete (Fin d)) ⋙ lim).obj M).val.obj V),
              (phi.inv.app M).val.app V x =
                ∑ i : Fin d, scalarPure a.val M V
                  ((Pi.lift (fun j : Fin d ↦ if i = j then 𝟙 _ else 0) ≫ theta.hom).val.app V
                    (@id ((unit (ringSheaf R)).val.obj V) (1 : R.obj.obj V)))
                  ((Pi.π (fun _ : Fin d ↦ M) i).val.app V x))) ∧
    (∀ {R S U : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}}
          (a : FiniteFreeScalarArrow J R S) (b : FiniteFreeScalarArrow J S U),
          ∃ (ab : FiniteFreeScalarArrow J R U) (_hab : ab.val = a.val ≫ b.val)
            (A : tensorFunctor a.val ⋙ tensorFunctor b.val ≅ tensorFunctor ab.val)
            (AT : projectionPost (I := ℕᵒᵖ) (tensorFunctor a.val) ⋙
                projectionPost (I := ℕᵒᵖ) (tensorFunctor b.val) ≅
                  projectionPost (I := ℕᵒᵖ) (tensorFunctor ab.val)),
            (∀ (M : ringedSiteModules.{u} (ringSheaf R)) (V : Cᵒᵖ)
              (s : S.obj.obj V) (z : U.obj.obj V) (x : M.val.obj V),
              (A.hom.app M).val.app V
                  (scalarPure b.val ((tensorFunctor a.val).obj M) V z
                    (scalarPure a.val M V s x)) =
                scalarPure ab.val M V (b.val.hom.app V s * z) x) ∧
            (∀ (M : ringedSiteModules.{u} (ringSheaf R)) (V : Cᵒᵖ)
              (z : U.obj.obj V) (x : M.val.obj V),
              (A.inv.app M).val.app V (scalarPure ab.val M V z x) =
                scalarPure b.val ((tensorFunctor a.val).obj M) V z
                  (scalarPure a.val M V 1 x)) ∧
            (∀ (X : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{u} (ringSheaf R)) (n : ℕᵒᵖ),
              (AT.hom.app X).app n = A.hom.app (X.obj n))) ∧
    (∀ R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u},
          ∃ (a : FiniteFreeScalarArrow J R R) (_ha : a.val = 𝟙 R)
            (U : tensorFunctor a.val ≅ 𝟭 (ringedSiteModules.{u} (ringSheaf R)))
            (UT : projectionPost (I := ℕᵒᵖ) (tensorFunctor a.val) ≅
              𝟭 (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{u} (ringSheaf R))),
            (∀ (M : ringedSiteModules.{u} (ringSheaf R)) (V : Cᵒᵖ)
              (r : R.obj.obj V) (x : M.val.obj V),
              (U.hom.app M).val.app V (scalarPure a.val M V r x) = r • x) ∧
            (∀ (X : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ ringedSiteModules.{u} (ringSheaf R)) (n : ℕᵒᵖ),
              (UT.hom.app X).app n = U.hom.app (X.obj n)))
